description: Ministry of Mahaweli Agriculture Arrigation and Rural Development Fixing a Certified Price to Purchase 16 Crops as per the Cabinet Decision
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes regulatory pricing for agricultural crops through a ministerial order based on a Cabinet decision. It creates a legal framework for mandatory farmgate prices, making it a regulatory matter under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it references a government official (the Secretary) and a ministry, the core content is about establishing enforceable price regulations rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications. The document functions as a statutory instrument setting compliance requirements for crop purchasing.
